name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
official: Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis
snapshot: The smallest country in the Americas, a two-island federation financed largely by selling citizenship to foreign investors.
culture: St Kitts was the first British colony in the Caribbean, and Brimstone Hill Fortress is UNESCO-listed. Its carnival, called Sugar Mas, runs from late November into January. Nevis, the sister island, was the birthplace of Alexander Hamilton. Masquerade troupes and string bands keep older traditions alive.
society: The sugar industry closed in 2005, and tourism and citizenship sales now dominate. The programme has faced US and EU scrutiny over security risks. Nevis has its own assembly and the constitutional right to secede, which it narrowly failed to use in a 1998 vote.
situation: Terrance Drew, a doctor, led the St Kitts and Nevis Labour Party to victory in 2022.
power: A federal parliamentary democracy and Commonwealth realm. The prime minister leads the majority in the National Assembly; Nevis has its own assembly and premier.

leaders.state: King Charles III, represented by a governor-general
